# T14 synthetic horseshoe ledger

All coordinates/expected values are synthetic test data, not measured aircraft inputs. Expected values were generated from the displayed special-geometry scalar hand expressions, without calling the Rust Biot-Savart code. Every coefficient in those expressions is a mathematical result from the synthetic coordinates; pi is the mathematical constant in the cited Biot-Savart integral.
